segments.zh: 生物安全柜必须按照标准操作

segments.text: in biological safety cabinets.

segments.text: In this video, I will be describing to you the layout of the standard biological safety
segments.zh: 在本视频中，我将向大家介绍标准生物安全

segments.text: cabinet.
segments.zh: 柜内的布局。

segments.text: This cabinet is designed to protect both the sample as well as the operator from exposure
segments.zh: 这种安全柜的设计目的，是同时保护样本和操作人员，使其免于暴露

segments.text: to the biological agent.
segments.zh: 于生物因子。

segments.text: As you can see, all your equipment within this biological safety cabinet has to be laid
segments.zh: 大家可以看到，生物安全柜内的所有器材都必须合理摆放，

segments.text: out so as to ensure a smooth working environment.
segments.zh: 以确保工作流程顺畅。

segments.text: These are the pipettes which are required for dispensing the samples which are located
segments.zh: 这些是分装样本所需的移液器，放在

segments.text: at this end.

segments.text: These are my pipette tips.
segments.zh: 这些是我的移液器吸头。

segments.zh: 这是要转移的样本，最后这里是我的废弃物容器。

segments.text: This waste container is specially designed for sharps and other disposable waste.
segments.zh: 这个废弃物容器是专门为利器和其他一次性废弃物设计的。

segments.text: For the purpose of our biological safety cabinet, pipette tips are considered as sharps
segments.zh: 就我们这台生物安全柜而言，移液器吸头被视为利器，

segments.text: and are disposed in this container.
segments.zh: 要丢弃在这个容器中。

segments.text: The container is filled to one-fourth of its level with a designated sterilant.
segments.zh: 容器中装有其四分之一容量的指定灭菌剂。

segments.text: In this case, I am using 70% ethanol.
segments.zh: 这里我使用的是 70% 乙醇。

segments.text: When we work, we generally work in a smooth flow.
segments.zh: 操作时，我们通常要保持流畅连贯。

segments.text: So as you can see, I am going to select the pipette.
segments.zh: 大家可以看到，我先拿起移液器。

segments.text: Then I install the pipette tip.
segments.zh: 然后装上移液器吸头。

segments.text: I set the volume and I am going to withdraw this sample from this bottle and dispense
segments.zh: 我设定好体积，然后从这个瓶子里吸取样本，

segments.text: it in the appropriate slot.
segments.zh: 并把它加到相应的孔位中。

segments.text: This is a smooth operation of the entire process.
segments.zh: 这就是整个流程的顺畅操作。

segments.text: When you complete dispensing the sample, the tips can be disposed in the waste container.
segments.zh: 样本分装完成后，吸头可以丢弃到废弃物容器中。

segments.text: There are some tips which one needs to note when working in this biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 在这台生物安全柜中操作时，有一些要点需要注意。

segments.text: This region basically has a downdraft of air which protects me as the operator from
segments.zh: 这个区域基本上有一股向下的气流，它既保护我这个操作人员免受

segments.text: this sample as well as protects the sample from any kind of contamination which may be
segments.zh: 样本的伤害，也保护样本不受

segments.text: produced in the environment.
segments.zh: 环境中可能产生的任何污染。

segments.text: Which is why we work within this zone.
segments.zh: 这就是我们要在这个区域内操作的原因。

segments.text: There are some things which you cannot do in a biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 有些事情是不能在生物安全柜中做的。

segments.text: For example, the usage of open flames is not permitted as the flame will generate a
segments.zh: 例如，不允许使用明火，因为火焰会产生

segments.text: convection current which can disturb the flow of air in this biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 对流，干扰生物安全柜内的气流。

segments.text: The second thing which you cannot do is operate centrifuges in this environment.
segments.zh: 第二件不能做的事，是在这种环境中运行离心机。

segments.text: As centrifuges have their own specific air flow patterns generated by their cooling motors
segments.zh: 因为离心机的冷却电机会产生其特有的气流模式，

segments.text: and this can in turn disturb the air flow.
segments.zh: 而这反过来又会干扰气流。

segments.text: These are some of the precautions which you need to take into consideration when working
segments.zh: 这些是在生物安全柜中操作时

segments.text: in a biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 需要考虑的一些注意事项。

segments.text: Now biological safety cabinets must be decontaminated prior to use using a specified sterilizing
segments.zh: 生物安全柜在使用前必须用指定的灭菌剂

segments.text: agent as well as ultraviolet light and disinfected post usage by using the same sterilant with
segments.zh: 和紫外线进行去污，使用后要用同一种灭菌剂进行消毒。关于

segments.text: regard to clean up of this cabinet after use, please ensure that you dispose of this
segments.zh: 使用后的清理，请确保当这个废物桶

segments.text: waste bin in a designated area and in accordance with the requisite standard operating procedure
segments.zh: 装到三分之二满时，按照相应的标准操作规程，

segments.text: when it achieves a level which is two thirds full.
segments.zh: 在指定区域进行处置。

segments.text: This bin has to be sealed and disposed of according to the standard operating procedure
segments.zh: 这个废物桶必须密封，并按照标准操作规程进行处置，

segments.text: which may involve autoclaving or incineration.
segments.zh: 可能包括高压灭菌或焚烧。

segments.text: These are some of the basic guidelines for utilizing a biological safety cabinet.
segments.zh: 以上是使用生物安全柜的一些基本指南。
